metadata.name: Gallows Yard
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A walled castle courtyard crowded with tomb blocks of every height, made in the spirit of the classic tombstone-courtyard arena. Embers and Tide each hold a gatehouse at one end; its roof runs into a raised walkway along the far wall, over a covered arcade and across a narrow bridge. Open stairs climb out of the graves, and jump pads throw you up onto the gallows in the middle, where the railgun waits above the rocket launcher.
